text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Lately, I've been having trouble 
falling asleep.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Even after getting into bed, my head and 
heart felt like they were floating... 
ten... twenty miles up into the sky?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking maybe the fatigue from the 
race is still lingering.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So... could you please reduce the number 
of races I run? Pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria reported that she still felt 
fatigued from the race. It might be 
necessary to reconsider her race schedule.
